CMP-011 forbids published host ports; CMP-022 requires main to set ports and extra_hosts, is Critical, is the newer C12 rule, and is what validate_task.py gates. The newer Critical rule wins. No sidecar publishes a port, which is the concurrency hazard CMP-011 exists to close.

CMP-014 recorded with its justification: the minio sidecar carries an mc-based healthcheck rather than the HTTP /minio/health/live probe reference/C C.3 records. The mc check authenticates and lists the bucket, so it proves the credentials the agent is given actually work, which a liveness probe does not. This is the corpus's shipped form and G55 accepts it.
